import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

np.random.seed(42)

n_spam = 50
n_not_spam = 50

X_spam = np.random.normal([5, 3, 7], [1, 1, 1], size=(n_spam, 3))
X_not_spam = np.random.normal([2, 5, 2], [1, 1, 1], size=(n_not_spam, 3))

X_train = np.vstack([X_spam, X_not_spam])
y_train = np.array([1]*n_spam + [0]*n_not_spam)

prior_spam = np.mean(y_train == 1)
prior_not_spam = np.mean(y_train == 0)

mean_spam = np.mean(X_train[y_train == 1], axis=0)
std_spam = np.std(X_train[y_train == 1], axis=0)
mean_not_spam = np.mean(X_train[y_train == 0], axis=0)
std_not_spam = np.std(X_train[y_train == 0], axis=0)

def predict(x):
    log_prior_spam = np.log(prior_spam)
    log_likelihood_spam = np.sum(stats.norm.logpdf(x, mean_spam, std_spam))
    log_posterior_spam = log_prior_spam + log_likelihood_spam

    log_prior_not_spam = np.log(prior_not_spam)
    log_likelihood_not_spam = np.sum(stats.norm.logpdf(x, mean_not_spam, std_not_spam))
    log_posterior_not_spam = log_prior_not_spam + log_likelihood_not_spam

    return 1 if log_posterior_spam > log_posterior_not_spam else 0

X_test = np.array([[4, 3, 6], [2, 6, 3], [6, 2, 8]])
predictions = np.array([predict(x) for x in X_test])

true_labels = np.array([1, 0, 1])
accuracy = np.mean(predictions == true_labels)

log_odds = (np.log(prior_spam) + np.sum(stats.norm.logpdf(X_test[0], mean_spam, std_spam)) -
            np.log(prior_not_spam) - np.sum(stats.norm.logpdf(X_test[0], mean_not_spam, std_not_spam)))

n_trials = 100
k_successes = 73
mle_p = k_successes / n_trials

print(f"Prior P(spam): {prior_spam:.4f}")
print(f"Predictions: {predictions}")
print(f"Accuracy: {accuracy:.4f}")
print(f"Log-odds for first test: {log_odds:.4f}")
print(f"MLE of p: {mle_p:.4f}")
